description_en: Returns a paginated list of domain names in your account

kebab_example: aliyun domain query-domain-list --end-expiration-date 1522080000000 --start-expiration-date 1522080000000 --user-client-ip 127.0.0.1 --lang en --query-type 1 --start-registration-date 1522080000000 --end-registration-date 1522080000000 --domain-name test.com --order-by-type ASC --order-key-type RegistrationDate --product-domain-type New_gTLD --page-num 1 --page-size 10 --domain-group-id 123456 --resource-group-id rg-aek2indvyxgpfti --tag Value=标签1 Key=备注 --ccompany '广州金烨再生资源回收有限公司' --registrar example-string --dns example-string --auto-renew-enabled true --api-version 2018-01-29 --region cn-hangzhou
